items.title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls
items.summary: The New York Times and a group of other publications have filed lawsuits against Brave ​Software over alleged unlawful scraping to train AI and also letting users bypass their paywalls.

items.title: A proposal: how to hire junior engineers in the age of AI
items.summary: Junior developer hiring has collapsed because nobody knows how to interview for the new AI-assisted job. Coding interviews are dead. The replacement: give candidates an LLM roleplaying as a customer, another LLM to build with, and see who figures out what to actually build.
items.interpretation: 这条信息说明模型能力、商业化速度或产品落地正在继续往前走，核心问题不再是“能不能做”，而是“谁先把能力变成持续收入”。

items.title: Embrace: RCE, Address Bar Spoofing and More in Cursor, Codex, Copilot and Claude
items.summary: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, VS Code and Claude Desktop each built a browser into their AI assistant, then enriched it beyond what a normal browser allows. Those enrichments broke the browser threat model, letting a web page or a local file reach the machine behind it. Two issues remain unpatched.
items.interpretation: 这条信息说明模型能力、商业化速度或产品落地正在继续往前走，核心问题不再是“能不能做”，而是“谁先把能力变成持续收入”。

items.title: Advisories in Five Months: Results from the Drupal AI Security Initiative
items.summary: Between June and October 2026, the Drupal Security Team published more advisories than in the previous 30 months combined. Five months into our SEIR grant, our data shows the shifting economics of discovery and why funding a complete workflow kept our volunteer process moving.
